notes.title: KELDER – Major Update 1.1
notes.notes:
Hello everyone,

I’ve been observing and taking notes from your gameplay and feedback, and working really hard to deliver this major update in a short time. This patch brings a lot of new content, system improvements, and bug fixes that should make the experience smoother, scarier, and more immersive.

                       [img src="{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/45051566/d7a135e269cef841a1727b0a5952926847b45ba5.gif"]
[hr][/hr]Top Highlights
New Journal System – keeps track of thoughts, tasks, and hints, with a UI notification for new notes.

Full Tutorial Section – learn the core mechanics through an integrated tutorial.

3 New Entities – each with unique stories and behaviours.

80+ New Events – complete overhaul of encounters and event system.

Lighting Overhaul – updated global illumination and post-processing for more comfortable visuals.

Expanded Levels – new paths, rooms, and more save points across multiple levels.

Keyboard Key binding – players can now rebind their keys.
[hr][/hr]Full Patch NotesNew Content
Added a Journal system for player thoughts, tasks, and hints.

Journal UI updates when a new note is added.

Added a full tutorial section with UI integration.

Introduced 3 new entities with unique stories and behaviours.

Added ~80 new events with a complete overhaul of the encounter system.
Gameplay & Systems
Save system updated with more save points and locations.

Save UI now notifies players when progress is saved.

Save system improved to prevent rare softlock cases on critical paths.

Players can now rebind keyboard keys from the controls menu.

Critical events rebalanced and updated.
Levels
Level 0 slightly updated; location changes in location of Map 1.

Level 1 updated with a new critical path at the end.

Level 2 expanded with more save points.

Level 3 extended with a large new room.
Other
Character camera post-processing updated.

Global illumination completely overhauled.

Player vision adjusted for short-distance visibility in low light.

PODV entity improved with new behaviour, effects, and encounters.

Darkness entity updated with better interactions.

Chairguy updated with improved door interactions.

Radio modified with better responses and fixed rare incorrect lines.

Player sound system updated for more accurate sound.

Added new sounds.

Fixed subtitle errors.

Fixed various visual bugs.

Interaction objects are now more responsive.

notes.title: KELDER - Update 1.1 is in the works!
notes.notes:
We’re excited to let you know that Update 1.1 is currently in development!
This update will include:



[img src="{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/45051566/88cae341491732be758d7ce2c12402b403392ea9.gif"]

New entities - some that were originally cut during development are finally making their way into the game.

Extended areas - environments have been expanded and adjusted to create a smoother, more fluid experience.

Upgraded systems - fresh tweaks and mechanics to keep you on your toes.



If you’ve already played the game, we’d love it if you could leave us a positive review - it really helps the game grow and reach more players.

And if you have feedback, please share it! I’m actively reading your comments, listening, and working hard to improve the game for everyone.

Thank you for being part of this journey - more details on Update 1.1 will be coming soon!

notes.title: KELDER – Development Update & Roadmap
notes.notes:
Hello everyone,

This past weekend, KELDER went live and many gamers and streamers had the chance to experience it. I've been carefully watching playthroughs, reading feedback, and taking notes on what worked and what needs improvement.

I want to share that KELDER will continue to receive regular updates until it fully becomes the ultimate horror experience I envision. Some content had to be cut due to time constraints, but I plan to reintroduce parts of it, expand on what's already there, and refine the overall experience to deliver a more intense and consistent sense of horror. I also aim to add additional language support so more players can experience KELDER.

Here's a look at what's coming in future updates:

    [img src="{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/45051566/3b905b29c2e390e833db639576823981fc9483bc.gif"]
Upcoming Changes & Additions[olist]
Entity Improvements – Smarter, more dynamic behavior for certain entities.

Expanded Areas – Some locations will be extended with new details and surprises.

Micro-Events – Additional random encounters in pathways to keep players on edge.

Critical Path Enhancements – More dynamics and clearer navigation hints.

Localization – More languages will be added.

Cut Content Returns – A few previously cut entities will be reintroduced (their documents and hints are already in-game).

Monster AI Upgrades – Both main monsters will become more responsive, adaptive, and engaged with the player.

Secret Events – Hidden environmental scares to reward exploration.

Readable Notes – More in-world notes to expand lore and improve immersion.

Customizable Controls – More rebindable options for comfortable play.

Endgame Summary – Final results screen at the end of each run.

Global Controller System – A refined feature that ensures every encounter is random, but now with more adaptive and sophisticated control tailored to each player's journey.
[/olist]
This is just the beginning. I'll be working continuously to shape KELDER into the horror experience it's meant to be. Thank you all for playing, streaming, and sharing your thoughts. Your feedback is driving the next phase of development, and I can't wait to show you what's next.

Stay tuned, and stay in the dark.
